## Preparation

library & load data

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
setwd('D:/GIS_Data/Vfl-oak/WekEO/')
load('dat_wek_2024.rda')
# dat_wek[dat_wek$year == 2024, ]
```

add Treat by meta data

```{r}
#setwd('D:/GIS_Data/Vfl-oak/WekEO/')
dat_meta <- read.csv('meta_data2.csv')

dat_all$key <- paste(dat_all$ID, '_', dat_all$Parcel, sep = '')

dat_all$los <- dat_all$eos - dat_all$sos

dat_wek <- merge(dat_all, dat_meta, by = 'key')

Treat_v <- dat_wek$Treat
Treat_v[Treat_v== "A-Grad"] <- 'Low'
Treat_v[Treat_v == "F-Grad" ] <- 'Medium'
Treat_v[Treat_v == "Z-Baum" ] <- 'High'


dat_wek$Treat_lvl <- factor(Treat_v, levels = c('Low', 'Medium', 'High'))
dat_wek
```

## Boxplot Pheno Dates

```{r}
sha.test <- shapiro.test(dat_wek[dat_wek$ID %in% c('Gei'),]$sos)
if (sha.test$p.value > 0.05) {norm <- "normal distribution"} else{norm <- "non-normal distribution"}
norm
sha.test$p.value
```

plot SOS

```{r}

plt <- ggplot(
  data = dat_wek[dat_wek$ID %in% c('Gei', 'Roh90', 'Roh620'),]
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(x = year, y = sos, group = interaction(year, ID, Treat_lvl), color = Treat_lvl)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2017.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2018.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2019.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2020.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2021.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2022.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = 2023.45),
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(2017:2024)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#00BFC4", "#E7B800", "#F8786D")
    ) +
  labs(
    title = "Interannual Comparison SOS",
    y = "DOY", x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 15
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ID
  ) +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
plt
```

## Heterogeneity - SD Pheno Metrics

calculate heterogeneity

```{r}

key_list <- unique(dat_wek$key)

for (key_i in 1:length(key_list)){
  key_n <- key_list[key_i]
  sub_key <- subset(dat_wek, key == key_n)
  plot <- unique(sub_key$ID)
  par <- unique(sub_key$Parcel)
  treat <- unique(sub_key$Treat_lvl)
  for (yr in 2017:2024){
    sub_yr <- subset(sub_key, year == yr)
    
    # count number of non-NA pixels
    pix_sos <- sum(!is.na(sub_yr$sos))
    pix_eos <- sum(!is.na(sub_yr$eos))
    pix_los <- sum(!is.na(sub_yr$los))
 
    
    # calculate sd of each index
    sd_sos <- sd(sub_yr$sos)
    sd_eos <- sd(sub_yr$eos)
    sd_los <- sd(sub_yr$los)
    
    # calculate mean of each index
    m_sos <- mean(sub_yr$sos)
    m_eos <- mean(sub_yr$eos)
    m_los <- mean(sub_yr$los)


    new <- data.frame(key = key_n, plot = plot, parcel = par, year = yr, Treat = treat, 
                      n_sos = pix_sos, n_eos = pix_eos, n_los = pix_los,
                      sd_sos = sd_sos, sd_eos = sd_eos, sd_los = sd_los,
                      m_sos = m_sos, m_eos = m_eos, m_los = m_los)
    if (yr == 2017){
      dat_yr <- new
    }else{
      dat_yr <- rbind(dat_yr, new)
    }
  }
  if (key_i == 1){
    dat_key <- dat_yr
  }else{
    dat_key <- rbind(dat_key, dat_yr)
  }

}

dat_key$cv_sos <- dat_key$sd_sos/dat_key$m_sos
dat_key$cv_eos <- dat_key$sd_eos/dat_key$m_eos
dat_key$cv_los <- dat_key$sd_los/dat_key$m_los
dat_key
#summary(dat_key)
#save(dat_key, file = 'dat_sd_2024.rda')
#load('dat_sd_2024.rda')
```

## Model Prep

load DWD data

```{r}
load('dat_dwd_2024.rda')
dat_dwd$key <- paste(dat_dwd$ID, '_', dat_dwd$Parcel, sep = '')
dat_dwd
```

```{r}
dat_dwd <- dat_dwd[, c('key', 'year', 'spr_temp', 'sum_temp', 'aut_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'aut_prec', 'spr_sund', 'aut_sund', 'stebo', 'stebv')]
dat_dwd
```

```{r}
dat_dwd$key_yr <- paste(dat_dwd$key, '_', dat_dwd$year, sep = '')
dat_wek$key_yr <- paste(dat_wek$key, '_', dat_wek$year, sep = '')
dat_key$key_yr <- paste(dat_key$key, '_', dat_key$year, sep = '')

dat_dwd_add <- dat_dwd[, c('key_yr', 'spr_temp', 'sum_temp', 'aut_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'aut_prec', 'spr_sund', 'aut_sund', 'stebo', 'stebv')]
dat_dwd_add
```

```{r}
dat_wek <- merge(dat_wek, dat_dwd_add, by = 'key_yr')
dat_wek
```

```{r}
dat_key <- merge(dat_key, dat_dwd_add, by = 'key_yr')
dat_key
```

Test correlation

```{r}
cor.test(dat_wek$spr_temp, dat_wek$stebo, method = "pearson")
```

## Model Pheno Dates

prepare data sos

```{r}
dat_sos <- dat_wek[, c('sos', 'ID', 'year', 'Treat_lvl', 'spr_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'spr_sund', 'stebo')]
colnames(dat_sos) <- c('sos', 'plot', 'year', 'treat', 'spr_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'spr_sund', 'stebo')
tr <- dat_sos$plot
tr[tr == 'Gei'] <- 'Pure'
tr[tr == 'Loh'] <- 'Mix'
tr[tr == 'Roh620'] <- 'Mix'
tr[tr == 'Roh635'] <- 'Mix'
tr[tr == 'Roh90'] <- 'Mix'

dat_sos$comp <- factor(tr, levels = c('Pure', 'Mix'))
dat_sos
```

linear mixed-effect model

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

mixed.lmer <- lmer(sos ~ treat + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + (1|year), data = dat_sos[dat_sos$plot %in% c('Gei'),])
summary(mixed.lmer)
```

```{r}
library(MuMIn)
r_sq_val <- r.squaredGLMM(mixed.lmer)
print(r_sq_val)

r.squaredGLMM(mixed.lmer)
```

compare models

```{r}
model_1 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + comp + spr_temp + stebo + (1|year), data = dat_sos)
model_2 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + comp + spr_temp + (1|year), data = dat_sos)
model_3 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + comp + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + (1|year), data = dat_sos)
model_4 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + (1|year) + (1|plot), data = dat_sos)
model_5 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + stebo + (1|year) + (1|plot), data = dat_sos)
model_6 <- lmer(sos ~ treat + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + (1|year) + (1|plot), data = dat_sos)
AIC(model_1, model_2, model_3, model_4, model_5, model_6)
```

random forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)
forest <- randomForest(sos ~ ., data = dat_sos, ntree = 200, mtry = 6, localImp = TRUE)
rf_model <- forest
RMSE <- min(sqrt(rf_model$mse))
RMSE
max(rf_model$rsq)
```

```{r}
r.squaredGLMM(mixed.lmer)
```

## Model Pheno Heterogeneity

prepare data sd sos

```{r}
dat_sds <- dat_key[, c('log_sds', 'plot', 'year', 'Treat', 'spr_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'spr_sund')]
colnames(dat_sds) <- c('sds', 'plot', 'year', 'treat', 'spr_temp', 'win_chill', 'spr_prec', 'spr_sund')
dat_sds
```

linear mixed-effect model

```{r}
#library(lme4)
#library(lmerTest)

mixed.lmer <- lmer(sds ~ treat + spr_temp + spr_prec + spr_sund + win_chill + (1|year), data = dat_sds[dat_sds$plot %in% c('Gei'),])  # intercept
summary(mixed.lmer)
```

```{r}
#library(MuMIn)
r_sq_val <- r.squaredGLMM(mixed.lmer)
print(r_sq_val)

r.squaredGLMM(mixed.lmer)
```

random forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)
forest <- tuneRF( x = dat_sds[, -which(names(dat_sds) == 'sds')],
        y = dat_sds$sds,
        mtryStart = 2,
        ntreeTry = 200,
        stepFactor = 1.5,
        improve = 0.01,
        plot = TRUE,
        doBest = TRUE)

rf_model <- forest
RMSE <- min(sqrt(rf_model$mse))
RMSE
max(rf_model$rsq)
```

importance plot

```{r}
library(vip)
vip(rf_model, num_features = 8, geom = "point", 
    aesthetics = list(color = "steelblue", size = 3)) +
  ggtitle("Variable Importance in Random Forest") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

```
